comparison.objective: Aim a loaded inspection arm and lock it at 15 degrees; candidate extracts a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand supports a gravity-loaded hinge while the other turns a locking knob versus one hand sustains dual-blade tang depression while the other pushes/pulls a wire.
comparison.success_condition: Arm remains locked at the target angle after release versus terminal remains extracted with connector and neighbors intact.
comparison.reason: Bimanual support while operating a mechanism is shared, but the task tests angular positioning and rotary locking rather than selective internal-contact extraction.
